entities.name: Fredrik Sjöström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fredrik Per Oscar Sjöström is a Swedish former professional ice hockey winger, and is currently the general manager of Frölunda HC of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Sjöström was drafted by the Phoenix Coyotes in the 1st round during the 2001 NHL Entry Draft. He would also play for the New York Rangers, Calgary Flames, and Toronto Maple Leafs.
